text:
lin: FYI staging build failed for the docs site after the i18n merge. mkdocs build errors out with a duplicate anchor id for 'installation' on /setup/guide/ — looks like two headings generate the same slug now.

i18n-bot: mkdocs-i18n: build error detected in preview #2021. See job: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/8021

docs-bot: build output (excerpt):
```
INFO    -  Building documentation...
ERROR   -  Duplicate ID 'installation' found on page 'setup/guide/index.md'.
  Located at: /docs/setup/guide/index.md:45
  Previous occurrence: /docs/setup/guide/index.md:10
Aborted with 1 errors.
```

eli: hmm, this usually happens when we have the same H2 twice (e.g., "Installation" under both "Server" and "Client") and the slugifier collapses them. Could be new slug rules from the i18n plugin that removed a differentiator like locale suffix.

priya: quick options: 1) add explicit ids to the headers we want to target, 2) make the headings unique (e.g., "Server installation" / "Client installation"), or 3) enable mkdocs-plugin-seo/slugification that appends incremental suffixes. I prefer explicit ids for stability.

lin: agree on explicit ids for the short-term. i'll add `{#installation-server}` and `{#installation-client}` where appropriate and update a couple of cross-page links that point to those anchors.

eli: also consider adding a CI check that catches duplicate IDs earlier (we already fail the build but a lighter pre-merge linkcheck would help). we can add `mkdocs serve --check` in the docs CI pre-check stage.

priya: small PR would be ideal. can you also include a short comment in the markdown explaining why the explicit id exists so translators don't remove it during localization? e.g., `<!-- explicit id: stable anchor for cross-links -->`.

lin: yep will do. local run: 
```
# after edits
mkdocs build
Building documentation to site directory
Documentation built successfully.
```

lin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4091 — title: "docs: disambiguate installation anchors in setup guide (i18n)". Changes: add explicit ids, update two internal links, add explanatory comments.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4091--docs.redwood.ai/setup/guide — preflight linkcheck passed.

eli: lgtm, please include the comment as priya suggested so the next translator doesn't strip the id. also leave a note in the i18n guide about preserving explicit heading ids for anchors.

priya: i'll add a small section to the translators.md in a follow-up PR.

lin: merging when CI green. will watch staging deploy. thanks all :rocket:
